session_id.description: The NetControlSession this check-in belongs to.

lat.description: Geocoded latitude for this check-in, looked up from the callsign. Used to plot the station on the live net map.

lng.description: Geocoded longitude for this check-in, looked up from the callsign. Used to plot the station on the live net map.

signal_report.description: Signal report given to this station (e.g. 5-9). Colors the station's pin on the live net map.

club_role.description: Snapshot of the member's club role at check-in time.

is_guest.description: Guest stations are added during a live net and are not part of the underlying roster.

checkin_type.description: The type of check-in. Club administrators configure which types count toward streaks.

notes.description: Operator notes for this station during the net.

session_owner_id.description: User id of the net operator. Stamped at creation so the operator can manage check-ins via RLS.

club_owner_id.description: User id of the club owner when the net uses a club roster.

checked_in_by_user_id.description: User id of the operator who performed this check-in. Used for audit and attribution.

checked_in_by_name.description: Display name of the operator who performed this check-in.

session_host_ids.description: Snapshot of all authorized host user ids at check-in time. Used for RLS read access by co-hosts.
